title: Norse in Newfoundland (tree-ring date)
summary: Wood from the Norse site at L'Anse aux Meadows was dated to 1021 using a known spike in radiocarbon from the year 993. It is the only confirmed Norse site in the Americas outside Greenland.
why: The earliest exact year for Europeans in the Americas outside Greenland, 471 years before Columbus.

notes.problem: 'Exactly 1021' overstates (source: 'pinpointed 1021 as a date of Norse activity'); 'first secure date for Europeans in the Americas' ignores Norse Greenland, which the summary itself excludes.
